text:
alex: Quick RFC follow-up — trying to reconcile iterator ergonomics across py/ts/go + transport prefetch windowing. dropping a short convo; pls react with concerns.

maria: quick q: do we change public signatures? i want minimal churn.

alex: public signatures stay. idea: transport adapters opt-in via a prefetch handshake + session window. SDKs expose zero new args by default.

jeff: need explicit rules for cancellation and dedupe across fallback transports. also how retries map to idempotency.

sam: propose a small classification adapters advertise: "atomicity" ∈ {resumable, idempotent, non_resumable}. resumable -> safe prefetch; non_resumable -> no prefetch.

natalie: backpressure: consumer might be slow. plan: coordinator grants tokens per-session. token-bucket semantics: tokens consumed for prefetch, refilled as consumer advances. adapters must stop when tokens=0.

li: billing/quota question: do reserved prefetched pages count toward quota immediately? ops will yell if unexpected charges.

alex: keep reservations soft: increment reserved_slots metric but only bill when page materializes and is returned. if eviction occurs, no charge. document in console.

maria: need metrics: reserved_slots, consumed_pages, dropped_prefetch, prefetch_retries. admin trace endpoint would help.

jeff: dedupe rule: any returned item must include resume_token with epoch+checksum. if transport returns a token that coordinator already saw, drop silently and release reservation. monotonic fallback guaranteed.

sam: retries: single logical RetryConfig per call. Prefetch follows same policy but adapters can cap prefetch_attempts (e.g. max 5). prefetch errors should not block current page; surface when user advances.

alex: API sketches (minimal):
```python
# python public surface unchanged
def pages(req, *, retry: RetryConfig|None=None) -> Iterator[Page]: ...
async def async_pages(req, *, retry: RetryConfig|None=None) -> AsyncIterator[Page]: ...
# transport registers hook: transport.register_prefetch(session_id, max_window=4, atomicity="resumable")
```
```ts
// ts public surface unchanged
function pages(req: Request, opts?: {retry?: RetryOpts}): AsyncIterable<Page> { /* ... */ }
// client.connect({transport:'grpc', prefetch:{enabled:true, maxWindow:2}})
```
```go
// go returns channels and uses context for cancellation
func Pages(ctx context.Context, req *Request, opts ...PageOption) (<-chan Page, <-chan error)
// transport:RegisterPrefetch(ctx, sessionID string, hint func(int))
```

natalie: UX opt: add disable_client_prefetch flag (rename from explicit_resume_only). default false for hosted, but default prefetch small (1) for hosted, higher for Dedicated.

li: private deployments: offer opt-in durable reservations (write-through) for auditability; default ephemeral reservations to avoid control-plane load. mark in RFC.

jeff: operational safety: prefetch backoff should be slightly more conservative than on-demand fetches to avoid aggressive fanout on fallback; add jitter and max_attempts_for_prefetch.

sam: also ensure context cancellation in go is honored by prefetch hooks and background retries stop quickly on ctx.Done().

alex: action items i will take: 1) include token-bucket per-session sketch + metrics list, 2) resume_token = token + epoch + checksum, 3) reserve-vs-bill semantics added, 4) disable_client_prefetch flag + defaults per deployment tier, 5) admin trace + optional durable reservations for Private.

maria: sounds good. please update RFC and drop a 30m sync invite.
